description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest update-service-usage --service-id service-39f4f251e94843xxxxxx --client-token AAAAAYChudnQUoBH+mGWFpb6oP0= --user-information key=example-string --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
